# Validation/publication

Read for authoring, checks or publication.

Own inbox/YYYY-MM-DD-purpose/ (suffix collisions): request.md records when/circumstances/reason/problem solved/result; clarify material unknowns, invent nothing. Without canonical instruction retain validation.md and full skill/resources or rule. Canonical creation needs explicit instruction+confirmation, possibly one request; do not re-ask. Saving request authorizes capture, otherwise ask. New harness folders need explained-example README.human.md; exclude bodies from reading/context/imports/evaluation.

Resolve catalog helpers; no author-home/cache dependencies. Applicable workflows: using-superpowers (real harness/scope); openai-docs (current official search+fetch); skill-creator (design, final skill quick_validate.py/nonempty metadata/folder equality); writing-skills (compact RED–GREEN–REFACTOR); plugin-eval routing → evaluate-skill analyze for skills/evaluate-plugin for actual manifests; improve-skill brief/required+recommended fixes via skill-creator/re-evaluate+compare; plugin-management integration/install.

Plain rules: skill-creator scope/non-duplication, [content](content-contract.md), conventions/conflicts/resources/compactness/both agents. No skill validator; generic analysis ≠ skill/plugin evaluation or native proof. Plugin rules: evaluate-plugin. Recheck fixes.

Missing tools: warn/offer authorized installation, mark unverified; installed ≠ verified. Benchmark/config/dependency writes need authorization.

Process each inbox on request: ownership/necessity/name. Edits invalidate statuses; repeat format/resources/helper behavior/RED–GREEN–REFACTOR/evaluation. In both modes test native listing, explicit own-resource use, implicit selection separately for Codex/Claude: common-only creates neutral project from common template; common+project preserves existing files. Project-only unsupported, only a rejection test.

Skeleton composition is explicit in harness/common/base/project-skeleton.json, never inferred from project folders. Change through common inbox only after a separate explicit user decision AND separate explicit user confirmation of usefulness to all projects; stop inclusion until both arrive. Proposal/silence ≠ approval.

Report date/version/files/commands/tools/agent versions/scope; contract/compactness method; pass/fail/not-run/N/A+reasons/findings/missing tools/next steps/agent-mode statuses. Static tokens ≠ measured usage; equality ≠ native proof.

Verified requires all mandatory checks and no correctness/discovery/behavior findings. Otherwise inbox until explicit permission for this unverified version/named source+native paths. Transfer/prior success/deadline ≠ waiver; exceptions retain statuses. After gate check complete ordinary copies/equality/Git/native behavior; new failures need current gate/exception. Current evidence in package checks, earlier in inbox.
content-contract.md:
# Content contract

Use when authoring or reviewing skills/rules.

State applicability, required action/restriction/invariant and observable compliance. Always applicable within a scope suffices; do not repeat clear metadata. Headings/count/order, including the old four sections, are optional; one sentence can suffice. Preserve this contract when compressing, including limits/approvals/stops, handling of missing data and resource access. Avoid repetition/speculation; order steps only for correctness. Keep details deferred, examples/reasons only to prevent concrete errors; explain violations separately only if ambiguous. Keep corrections as required behavior, history/detailed rationale in inbox/lessons/reports.

Installed tools/resources must remain available: say when/how to access; portable links, no symlinks. Separate platform actions.

## Skills

A folder with SKILL.md: YAML frontmatter, nonempty name/description, then Markdown.

- name: 1–64 characters; a-z/digits/hyphens, none leading/trailing/consecutive; matches folder; shared comm-/proj- prefix.
- description: 1–1024 characters; capability/precise activation, algorithms/constraints in body.
- SKILL.md alone suffices for agents. Optional resources: references/ guidance, scripts/ actions, assets/ outputs; define their use.
- Optional agents/openai.yaml: UI name/description/icons, invocation policy/dependencies. Harness README.human.md requirements remain; never load bodies.

## Rules

Markdown; applicability/behavior in body, no paths here. Always-loaded placement needs a requirement before skill selection. Claude reads only paths, ignores other frontmatter and strips it from context: metadata cannot express scope. Check Codex loading separately.
placement-contract.md:
# Placement

Read when saving/installing. Complete ordinary copies; no symlinks.

| Material | Source | Native copies |
|---|---|---|
| Shared skill | harness/common/skills/comm-name or harness/project/skills/proj-name | identical same-name folders in .agents/skills and .claude/skills |
| Shared rule | harness/common/rules/comm-name.md or harness/project/rules/proj-name.md | same-name file directly in .claude/rules/; no Codex mirror |
| Explicit personal skill | .agents/skills/name | .claude/skills/name |

Common portable and required for harness; project dependent. Personal prefixes optional; canonical requirements prevail; conflicts need user decision.

Edit source once. Verify ordinary files/equal sets/bytes/Git visibility. Shared source/copies visible; automatically .gitignore exact personal paths, preserve entries, never whole native roots. Ignoring does not untrack.

Rules: former octadim/personal scheme revoked; classify common/project by content. After gate save source/copy together, no extra approval; stop on differing other-owner files. Claude loads natively; Codex reads recursively via AGENTS.md, not native import. Entrypoint check restores that instruction, never publishes rules.
